description: Get one bridge by its FHWA structure number (Item 8). Structure numbers are unique within a state; pass state to be exact. Returns the full decoded record. Read-only; no API key. If no bridge matches, the call errors; if state is omitted and the number matches in more than one state, the call errors, pass state to be exact. Use search_bridges instead for fuzzy or name-based lookups.
name: get_bridge
